Monica — thanks for the logistics and the agenda. Quick heads up: we've just been notified of a surprise internal audit that will require our CFO to be on-site Friday morning (11/20) through early afternoon. That pulls our primary sponsor and one other exec out of the morning session.

We absolutely want to keep the workshop and get to the outcomes you outlined — options on our end:
- Move the session to Monday 11/23 (we still need to check other calendars)
- Keep Friday but shift start to 12:30pm and run an abbreviated afternoon session with the rest remote in the morning
- Run Friday as planned but have the CFO join remotely after the audit (if Redwood can provide robust remote facilitation)

Apologies for the late-notice; this audit came up this afternoon. Please let us know what'd be easiest for Redwood operationally — we don't want to cause unnecessary cancellations.

Susan Lambert
VP, Corporate Strategy | Aurora Energy

Thanks Susan — I appreciate the quick flag. We have three practical options from Redwood ops and facilitation that should fit the scenarios you listed. My assessment below; I can execute whichever you prefer.

Option A (recommended): Move to Monday 11/23 full day. Pros: preserves full agenda, avoids rushing, keeps in-person value. Cons: travel rebooking for some attendees.

Option B: Keep Friday but start at 12:30pm and split the agenda to two half-days (Fri afternoon + follow-up virtual half-day next Tuesday). Pros: less travel churn; preserves live collaboration. Cons: requires adjusting a few breakouts.

Option C: Keep schedule but run hybrid with the CFO remote after audit; Redwood will provide dedicated remote facilitator + backup AV engineer to ensure the remote experience is seamless. Pros: smallest change for Aurora travel. Cons: remote participation may reduce some in-room dynamic.

Operational notes (what we'll do now):
- HOLD: We'll put hotel and travel cancellation on hold; do NOT finalize refunds for 48 hours.
- ATTACH: I uploaded a quick revision (agenda_v2.pdf) that trims a few optional breakouts if you prefer Option B/C.
- OFFER: Redwood can cover one-night hotel for any attendee who needs to extend because of rescheduling or provide a travel credit toward rebooking.

Ethan / Dylan — can you please:
1) confirm we can reconfigure the AV setup for a robust hybrid (dedicated Teams room + second local mic + remote breakout channels) if Susan goes with C
2) put travel on hold and produce a one-line stub for finance (travel_hold_ticket_stub.txt)

Susan — call out which option you prefer and I'll lock it down and send a confirmed itinerary + updated DocuSign agenda sign-off link.

Best,
Monica
